samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Design a frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency of 100MHz into 50MHz, 10MHz, and 1MHz signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="div_50">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 2.</parameter>
        <parameter id="div_10">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 10.</parameter>
        <parameter id="div_1">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 100.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="div_50">
            <description>Divide the input clock frequency by 2.</description>
            <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
            <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
            <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
            <implementation>
                <assign id="CLK_50">The output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</assign>
                <always>
                    <description>On every positive edge of CLK_in or RST, if RST is active, CLK_50 is set to 0. Otherwise, CLK_50 is toggled by inverting its current value.</description>
                    <if id="RST">Reset signal is active.</if>
                    <else>Toggle CLK_50 by inverting its current value.</else>
                </always>
            </implementation>
        </sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="div_10">
            <description>Divide the input clock frequency by 10.</description>
            <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
            <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
            <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
            <implementation>
                <assign id="CLK_10">The output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</assign>
                <always>
                    <description>On every positive edge of CLK_in or RST, if RST is active, CLK_10 is set to 0, and the counter cnt_10 is reset to 0. If the counter cnt_10 reaches a value of 9, CLK_10 is toggled by inverting its current value, and the counter cnt_10 is reset to 0. Otherwise, the counter cnt_10 is incremented by 1.</description>
                    <if id="RST">Reset signal is active.</if>
                    <elseif id="cnt_10">Counter cnt_10 reaches a value of 9.</elseif>
                    <else>Increment the counter cnt_10 by 1.</else>
                </always>
            </implementation>
        </sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="div_1">
            <description>Divide the input clock frequency by 100.</description>
            <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
            <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
            <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
            <implementation>
                <assign id="CLK_1">The output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</assign>
                <always>
                    <description>On every positive edge of CLK_in or RST, if RST is active, CLK_1 is set to 0, and the counter cnt_100 is reset to 0. If the counter cnt_100 reaches a value of 99, CLK_1 is toggled by inverting its current value, and the counter cnt_100 is reset to 0. Otherwise, the counter cnt_100 is incremented by 1.</description>
                    <if id="RST">Reset signal is active.</if>
                    <elseif id="cnt_100">Counter cnt_100 reaches a value of 99.</elseif>
                    <else>Increment the counter cnt_100 by 1.</else>
                </always>
            </implementation>
        </sequential_logic>
    </logic_description>
</module>
